# Independent v0.10 integration review

## Source verdict

PASS for the integration source bound by V010-REVIEW-PINS.json. Final clean delivery replay remains a separate required gate, not implied by this source review.

The new adapter calculates then independently verifies against the original external request. The certificate-only operation imports neither producer nor request contract, and rejects malformed or mismatched evidence without a partial result. Successful receipts preserve the fixed catalog and supplied-splitting assumptions; formal proof, runtime-goal acceptance, actual geometric realization and map-rank claims remain false. Unknown failures become bounded internal-error receipts.

The two new bridge contracts are appended after the twelve byte-for-byte-equivalent prior definitions. No old mathematical backend or runtime registry changes were found. The CLI additions route to bounded file readers; the bridge exposes structured mathematical data only, not user-selected paths, commands, maps, credentials or group catalogs. Strict schemas describe shape and do not replace arithmetic verification or exact runtime type checks.

## Independent executable evidence

The separately written v010_review.py passes 9,753 checks in normal and optimized Python. It covers every physical irreducible across eleven source degrees and seven twists; rank, twisted degree, both cohomology dimensions and Euler dimension are independently calculated by integer formulas. Every same-degree irrep pair satisfies the independently expected ordinary Hom dimension and physical Schur invariant dimension. Forged output dimensions and changed external requests are rejected.

The scalar-channel regression distinguishes H0=1+V and H1=1 from Euler=V. The two split bundles with equal Euler characters retain their differing H0. Verification succeeds with imports of the producer and its request contract deliberately blocked. Bool, float and string substitutions fail exact integer guards. Forged geometry scope fails through the bridge with tool_error, not acceptance. Implementation hashes match actual files. The review also enforces all eight reviewed source-file pins, so re-freezing changed reviewed sources does not silently inherit this verdict. The old twelve schemas and inherited backend/runtime source hashes agree with the frozen base.

The existing independently reviewed standalone lab provides the deeper complete character arithmetic oracle, 22,093 checks, 601 author checks and eight source mutations. These remain separate evidence, not claimed as new integration checks or formal proofs.

## Packaging and limits

The builder selects only explicitly named regular files, rejects absolute/traversing paths and symlinks, pins inherited inputs and uses deterministic ZIP metadata. The aggregate uses embedded authenticated base/lab archives rather than sibling checkouts, runs both modes, requires the independent review, verifies unchanged selected sources and checks privacy/portability strings. A changed source during a run invalidates that run. Final manifest-only extraction and byte-identical rebuild must still pass before delivery.

All mathematical outputs are conditional on supplied formal equivariant splitting and catalog identification. Hom dimension is not rank of a map, and Euler equality is not equality of cohomology or splitting. Real Lean remains unavailable, explicitly skipped rather than passed. No actual research object, parameter, coefficient, evaluated jet or instance matrix was used in this review.
